appointments_check_order.name: appointments_check_order
appointments_check_order.value: "appointments"."checked_out_at" IS NULL OR ("appointments"."checked_in_at" IS NOT NULL AND "appointments"."checked_out_at" >= "appointments"."checked_in_at")

appointments_bounded.name: appointments_bounded
appointments_bounded.value: NOT isempty("appointments"."during") AND NOT lower_inf("appointments"."during") AND NOT upper_inf("appointments"."during")

busy_intervals_bounded.name: busy_intervals_bounded
busy_intervals_bounded.value: NOT isempty("busy_intervals"."during") AND NOT lower_inf("busy_intervals"."during") AND NOT upper_inf("busy_intervals"."during")

clients_erased.name: clients_erased
clients_erased.value: "clients"."erased_at" IS NULL OR ("clients"."email" IS NULL AND "clients"."phone" IS NULL AND "clients"."notes" IS NULL AND "clients"."access_notes_enc" IS NULL AND "clients"."account_id" IS NULL)

feed_tokens_active_staff.name: feed_tokens_active_staff
feed_tokens_active_staff.where: "feed_tokens"."staff_id" IS NOT NULL AND "feed_tokens"."revoked_at" IS NULL

invoices_terms.name: invoices_terms
invoices_terms.value: ("invoices"."terms_days" IS NULL AND "invoices"."due_on" IS NULL) OR ("invoices"."terms_days" IS NOT NULL AND "invoices"."due_on" IS NOT NULL AND "invoices"."terms_days" BETWEEN 0 AND 365 AND "invoices"."due_on" = "invoices"."issued_on" + "invoices"."terms_days")

invoices_due_set.name: invoices_due_set
invoices_due_set.value: "invoices"."credit_of" IS NOT NULL OR ("invoices"."terms_days" IS NOT NULL AND "invoices"."due_on" IS NOT NULL)

services_link_https.name: services_link_https
services_link_https.value: "services"."link_url" IS NULL OR ("services"."link_url" LIKE 'https://%' AND length("services"."link_url") <= 500)

shop_announcements_text.name: shop_announcements_text
shop_announcements_text.value: length("shop_announcements"."text_fr") <= 500 AND length("shop_announcements"."text_en") <= 500 AND length("shop_announcements"."text_fr") + length("shop_announcements"."text_en") > 0 AND length("shop_announcements"."photo_alt") <= 200

shop_announcements_photo.name: shop_announcements_photo
shop_announcements_photo.value: "shop_announcements"."photo_url" IS NULL OR ("shop_announcements"."photo_url" LIKE 'https://%' AND length("shop_announcements"."photo_url") <= 500)

shop_page_template_pair.name: shop_page_template_pair
shop_page_template_pair.value: ("shop_page"."template_id" IS NULL) = ("shop_page"."template_version" IS NULL) AND ("shop_page"."template_version" IS NULL OR "shop_page"."template_version" >= 1)

shop_page_logo_https.name: shop_page_logo_https
shop_page_logo_https.value: "shop_page"."logo_url" IS NULL OR ("shop_page"."logo_url" LIKE 'https://%' AND length("shop_page"."logo_url") <= 500)

shop_page_logo_dark_https.name: shop_page_logo_dark_https
shop_page_logo_dark_https.value: "shop_page"."logo_dark_url" IS NULL OR ("shop_page"."logo_dark_url" LIKE 'https://%' AND length("shop_page"."logo_dark_url") <= 500)

shop_reels_kind.name: shop_reels_kind
shop_reels_kind.value: ("shop_reels"."kind" = 'upload' AND ("shop_reels"."mp4_url" IS NOT NULL OR "shop_reels"."webm_url" IS NOT NULL) AND "shop_reels"."platform" IS NULL) OR ("shop_reels"."kind" = 'external' AND "shop_reels"."platform" IS NOT NULL AND "shop_reels"."external_url" IS NOT NULL AND "shop_reels"."embed_url" IS NOT NULL)

shop_reels_urls.name: shop_reels_urls
shop_reels_urls.value: coalesce("shop_reels"."mp4_url", 'https://') ~ '^https://' AND coalesce("shop_reels"."webm_url", 'https://') ~ '^https://' AND coalesce("shop_reels"."poster_url", 'https://') ~ '^https://' AND coalesce("shop_reels"."external_url", 'https://') ~ '^https://' AND coalesce("shop_reels"."embed_url", 'https://') ~ '^https://'

shop_reviews_texts.name: shop_reviews_texts
shop_reviews_texts.value: length("shop_reviews"."body") <= 1000 AND length("shop_reviews"."reply") <= 1000 AND length("shop_reviews"."first_name") <= 40 AND length("shop_reviews"."last_initial") <= 2 AND length("shop_reviews"."service_name") <= 120

shop_wall_items_place.name: shop_wall_items_place
shop_wall_items_place.value: "shop_wall_items"."x" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "shop_wall_items"."y" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "shop_wall_items"."rotation" BETWEEN -8 AND 8 AND "shop_wall_items"."z" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000

shop_wall_items_texts.name: shop_wall_items_texts
shop_wall_items_texts.value: length("shop_wall_items"."caption_fr") <= 40 AND length("shop_wall_items"."caption_en") <= 40 AND length("shop_wall_items"."text_fr") <= 140 AND length("shop_wall_items"."text_en") <= 140 AND length("shop_wall_items"."signature") <= 40 AND length("shop_wall_items"."alt_fr") <= 200 AND length("shop_wall_items"."alt_en") <= 200

shop_wall_items_image.name: shop_wall_items_image
shop_wall_items_image.value: "shop_wall_items"."image_url" IS NULL OR ("shop_wall_items"."image_url" LIKE 'https://%' AND length("shop_wall_items"."image_url") <= 500)

shop_zones_position.name: shop_zones_position
shop_zones_position.value: ("shop_zones"."lat" IS NULL) = ("shop_zones"."lng" IS NULL) AND ("shop_zones"."lat" IS NULL OR ("shop_zones"."lat" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "shop_zones"."lng" BETWEEN -180 AND 180))

shops_public_text.name: shops_public_text
shops_public_text.value: length(coalesce("shops"."area", '')) <= 80 AND length(coalesce("shops"."bio_fr", '')) <= 600 AND length(coalesce("shops"."bio_en", '')) <= 600 AND length(coalesce("shops"."public_phone", '')) <= 40 AND length(coalesce("shops"."public_email", '')) <= 120 AND length(coalesce("shops"."seat_unit_fr", '')) <= 30 AND length(coalesce("shops"."seat_unit_en", '')) <= 30

shops_slug_format.name: shops_slug_format
shops_slug_format.value: "shops"."slug" IS NULL OR ("shops"."slug" ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$' AND length("shops"."slug") BETWEEN 3 AND 40)

shops_invoice_mail_from_name.name: shops_invoice_mail_from_name
shops_invoice_mail_from_name.value: "shops"."invoice_mail_from_name" IS NULL OR length("shops"."invoice_mail_from_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 120

visit_reports_photo_type.name: visit_reports_photo_type
visit_reports_photo_type.value: ("visit_reports"."photo" IS NULL) = ("visit_reports"."photo_type" IS NULL) AND ("visit_reports"."photo_type" IS NULL OR "visit_reports"."photo_type" IN ('jpeg','png','webp'))
